Name: Better Fishing (1.6 Compatibility)
Author: CrazyBarkss
Description:
A compatibility patch for Better Fishing to be used with 1.6, this is still a work in progress, but completely functional.
Feel free to [url=https://github.com/Crazybarks/BettererFishing]check the source code[/url] yourself, though you might go mad looking at my ineptitude with code lol

From [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13585]original page[/url]:
[quote]One of the most balanced fishing assistant mod. Have a try!

Make fishing no longer a boring and tiring work.
Save your precious time and energy.
Let you enjoy your life in Pelican Town.


Unbreakable Tackle: Tackles won't wear out. ( not vanilla but rational )

Skip Fishing Mini Game: The perfect chance depends on fish difficulty, fish behavior, and bobberbar height. Stimulate the game progress as vanilla as possible. Only for ordinary fish.

Skip Fishing Mini Game Of Legendary Fish: Literally.

Junk Does Not Reduce Bait: Baits won't be consumed by rubbish. ( Baits attract rubbish? That's doesn't make any sense )

Auto Reel In Fish: Reel in fish automatically when it nibbling.

Auto Obtain Treasure Chest: Obtain treasure chests automatically.

Auto Grab Treasure Loot: Grab items from treasure chests automatically.

[s]Always Perfect: Always be perfect if you skip the mini game.[/s]

Always Cast Max Distance: Always cast the max distance.


Please comment if you have any suggestion or problem![/quote]
